search_method: Official Fortinet Document Library searches across Administration Guide, Configuration Guide, New Features Guide, architecture/deployment and release-specific material. Primary topic selection was driven by the feature documentation, not a fixed topic list.

direct_open_limitations.mitigation: Search-indexed official guide content and CLI/reference excerpts were used; all exact source URLs are linked in each lesson. Direct page review remains incomplete and should be retried through a documentation-capable session.

guide_families_searched: DNS server and DNS filter configuration
products.selected_feature: DoQ/DoH3 transparent and local-in DNS proxy-mode inspection, listener modes, certificate selection.

guide_families_searched: Workspace settings and ADOM workflow documentation
products.selected_feature: Individual concurrent workflow sessions, selective approval groups, conflict handling and separate install boundary.

guide_families_searched: Report Guidance and auto-cache feature documentation
products.selected_feature: Report object graph, Report Guidance availability and persistent hcache precomputation.

guide_families_searched: FortiSwitchOS VLAN and interface configuration reference
products.selected_feature: Private VLAN primary/isolated/community forwarding matrix and promiscuous/host port roles.
Default mesh bootstrap SSID, Ethernet-first leaf behavior and controller authorization.

guide_families_searched: Security Events and Security Incidents implementation
products.selected_feature: Syslog field normalization, severity mapping, host correlation, event triggers and alarm action precedence.

guide_families_searched: Device Profiling Rules and source rank
products.selected_feature: Per-MAC fingerprint records, multiple evidence sources, source rank and rogue-to-registered rule transition.

guide_families_searched: Accounting proxy sources, rule sets and destinations
products.selected_feature: RADIUS accounting source/destination mapping, attribute add/rename, LDAP-derived group and RSSO fan-out.

guide_families_searched: Secret policies, secret configuration and launcher workflow
products.selected_feature: Additional Access Authentication at policy and secret levels, override semantics and time-limited edit/launch gate.

guide_families_searched: FortiAI Incident Analysis workflow and analyst UI
products.selected_feature: Agentic incident plan, sequential SQL evidence handoff, false-positive analysis and persistence.

guide_families_searched: SIA/SWG application control and inspection architecture
products.selected_feature: Inline-CASB IPS decoder, TLS deep inspection, QUIC fallback and application override precedence.

guide_families_searched: ADVPN 2.0 edge discovery and path management
products.selected_feature: ADVPN 2.0 shortcut query/reply, transport groups, health-aware path selection and overlay placeholders.

selection_policy: Primary lesson source is an official feature/architecture/configuration/admin/release guide. Community/KB/TAC sources are only scenario evidence. A candidate is rejected when mechanism/workflow/evidence/remediation/question/topology fingerprints substantially match any published lesson in the 30-day inventory.
